family_labels.moe.routed.gemm: routed MoE: expert GEMM (DeepGEMM fp8xfp4 / MegaMoE / ref fp4_gemm)
family_labels.moe.swiglu: MoE SwiGLU+quant (routed and shared share one kernel name)
family_labels.moe.routed.staging: routed MoE: staging/prep (dedup, cold stage over C2C, SF pack, act quant bcast, gathers)
family_labels.moe.shared: shared expert (fp8 GEMV inside the moe range)
family_labels.moe.router: router (gate fp32, plan, pre/post, top-k inside the moe range)
family_labels.dense.proj: dense projections (fp8 GEMV outside moe: q/kv/o + engram/compressor/indexer linears)
family_labels.dense.head: head (fixed-order fp32 / bf16-stored head, cuBLAS head)
family_labels.fp8_gemv.unsplit: fp8 GEMV, call site not resolvable (no NVTX role)
family_labels.glue.norm_mhc: glue: norms + mHC (hc_norm, norm_row, sinkhorn, hc_post, mixes)
family_labels.glue.indexer: glue: indexer top-k/sort (outside the moe range)
family_labels.topk.unsplit: torch top-k/sort, router vs indexer not resolvable (no NVTX role)
family_labels.glue.torch: glue: torch residual (elementwise, reduce, cat, index, cub, asserts)
